# cachekit

> Unified caching for Rust: in-memory (moka) and Redis backends with TTL,
> stale-while-revalidate, and eviction listeners behind one caching interface
> with swappable backends.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): cache semantics, backend selection, quick start.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-CP-001..901 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
